text:
Ivy: dropped two new mocks for billing overview: 'compact-lines' vs 'card-stack'. want quick UX + a11y sanity checks before the design review.
Mark: link?
Ivy: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/billing-overview-compact-vs-cards
Sofia: compact-lines feels clean for power users, shows more rows, but important CTAs (download/pay) are in the kebab.
Ben: card-stack surfaces actions but pushes summary metrics below the fold. mobile scrolling could be annoying.
Rae: a11y: token shorthand like "3.2k" is read oddly by VoiceOver. recommend aria-label="3,200 tokens" and visible tooltip on hover.
designbot: Ivy uploaded updated files (compact-lines-v3, card-stack-v2)
Ivy: noted. Also thinking about visual hierarchy: current column order is Date | Project | Tokens | Amount | Actions. maybe swap Tokens and Amount to align numeric weight.
Mark: swapping makes sense. numeric columns grouped helps horizontal scanning.
Sofia: small UX question: where do we show invoice status (Paid / Overdue)? leftmost badge? inline chip? floating filter?
Ben: left badge works well for quick scannability. make overdue badge high contrast and add aria-label="Overdue invoice".
Rae: contrast check: overdue red on dark theme is 3.7:1. needs >=4.5:1. also focus ring on kebab menu is barely visible; add 3px wide outline or use system focus color.
Ivy: good catches. On accidental payments: do not surface a primary Pay button on every row. propose small inline "Pay" only for overdue >30d, otherwise keep Pay in overflow. add a micro-confirm for Pay.
Mark: +1. analytics idea: A/B test compact-lines+mini-sparkline vs card-stack with visible actions. Track: invoice_download_click, pay_initiated, pay_confirmed, rows_expanded_per_session, support_ticket_keyword:"invoice".
Sofia: mini-sparkline helps scanning trends. if included, ensure aria-label like "Usage trend last 30 days: stable" and role="img". color palette must be colorblind-safe.
Ben: keyboard nav: in compact-lines chevron is not in tab order. make the entire row focusable and Enter toggles expansion; ensure tab order after checkbox goes to row, then kebab.
Rae: also provide aria-live region for bulk download completion if user initiates a large zip so screen reader gets feedback.
Ivy: I'll make these updates: swap numeric columns, add aria-labels for shorthand tokens, bump overdue contrast, make rows focusable, add optional sparklines with labels, and prototype Pay micro-confirm. Re-uploading in ~40m.
Mark: sounds good. adding a 5m pilot proposal to agenda: split 25/25/50 for compact+sparkline, card-stack, control.
Sofia: no other a11y blockers from design side.
Ben: payments infra ok with micro-confirm.
Ivy: great, thanks team :thumbsup:
